name: Eagles

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles country-rock band formed in 1971. Stacked harmony and acoustic/electric songwriting mark the early records; Hotel California (1976) adds dual-lead guitar and becomes the main AOR reference.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶 country-rock 乐队，1971 年成立。早期作品以叠和声与原声/电声写法为主；Hotel California（1976）加入双主音吉他，成为主要的 AOR 参照。

lyricQuotes: Welcome to the Hotel California / Such a lovely place
Take it easy / Take it easy / Don't let the sound of your own wheels drive you crazy

shortBio.en: LA country-rock to Hotel California dual-lead AOR; Take It Easy is the debut radio single.
shortBio.zh: 洛杉矶 country-rock 到 Hotel California 双主音 AOR；Take It Easy 是出道电台单曲。

body.en:
The Eagles formed in 1971 from Linda Ronstadt’s backing circle—Glenn Frey, Don Henley, Bernie Leadon, and Randy Meisner. Early Eagles (1972) and Desperado (1973) sold stacked harmony and acoustic/electric country-rock. Don Felder joined mid-decade; Joe Walsh replaced Leadon in 1975, and the guitar weight rose.

Hotel California (1976), produced with Bill Szymczyk, is the central album: 12-string arpeggio intro, Felder/Walsh dual-lead trade, Henley vocal. Life in the Fast Lane is the Walsh riff hard-rock track on that LP. Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975) and Hotel California rank among the best-selling US catalog titles of the period.
body.zh:
Eagles 于 1971 年从 Linda Ronstadt 伴奏圈组建——Glenn Frey、Don Henley、Bernie Leadon 与 Randy Meisner。早期 Eagles（1972）与 Desperado（1973）以叠和声与原声/电声 country-rock 为主。Don Felder 在十年中期加入；Joe Walsh 于 1975 年替换 Leadon，吉他比重上升。

Hotel California（1976，Bill Szymczyk 参与制作）是核心专辑：十二弦琶音 intro、Felder/Walsh 双主音对答、Henley 人声。Life in the Fast Lane 是该专辑上的 Walsh riff 硬摇滚曲。Their Greatest Hits（1971–1975）与 Hotel California 位列同期美国销量最高的目录作品之列。

title.zh: 从 country-rock 到双主音 AOR

body.en:
The Eagles began as harmony country-rock from the Ronstadt pool. Felder and Walsh added Les Paul and Strat dual leads without dropping the vocal stacks.

Hotel California is the hinge record: mid-tempo narrative, precise studio arrangement, and a guitar duel as climax rather than a blues jam.

The craft sits in session discipline and FM-length hooks.
body.zh:
Eagles 从 Ronstadt 圈子起步，作和声 country-rock。Felder 与 Walsh 加入 Les Paul 与 Strat 双主音，同时保留人声叠层。

Hotel California 是转折专辑：中速叙事、精确录音室编排，以及以吉他对答作高潮，而非蓝调 jam。

工艺落在录音室纪律与适合 FM 长度的钩子。

title.en: Leadon out, Felder and Walsh in
title.zh: Leadon 离队，Felder 与 Walsh 加入

body.en:
Leadon left in 1975; Walsh brought James Gang hard-rock vocabulary. Felder was already on One of These Nights.

Meisner left after Hotel California; Timothy B. Schmit joined for The Long Run.

The strongest studio stretch is Frey/Henley writing with Felder/Walsh leads, 1975–1979.
body.zh:
Leadon 于 1975 年离队；Walsh 带入 James Gang 硬摇滚语汇。Felder 已在 One of These Nights 上录音。

Meisner 在 Hotel California 后离队；Timothy B. Schmit 加入 The Long Run。

最强录音室阶段是 Frey/Henley 写作与 Felder/Walsh 主音，约 1975–1979。

title.zh: 美国电台上的双主音 AOR

body.en:
The Hotel California guitar coda is a widely cited dual-lead AOR arrangement. Later Los Angeles and arena bands used similar polish-plus-riff mixes.

Sales history is part of the story: Greatest Hits and Hotel California as US catalog anchors.

Influence runs more through production and arrangement than through punk or metal ideology.
body.zh:
Hotel California 吉他尾奏是常被引用的双主音 AOR 编排。后来洛杉矶与体育场乐队使用相近的抛光加 riff 混搭。

销量也是事实的一部分：Greatest Hits 与 Hotel California 是美国目录锚点。

影响更多落在制作与编排，而非朋克或金属意识形态。
